keySentence: Alice fell down the rabbit hole.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Alice fell down and down. She saw strange things. She landed in a small room. Alice fell down the rabbit hole.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Alice tumbled down the rabbit hole for a very long time. She passed shelves full of books, maps, and jars of jam. Alice fell down the rabbit hole into a mysterious world below. She landed softly in a small room with many locked doors. There was a tiny golden key on a glass table in the middle. Alice picked it up and wondered which door it would open.
facts.Word cards: deep = 깊은 / shelves = 선반 / kept falling = 계속 떨어졌다 / pictures = 그림들
